summary.text: Jerome Zeringue is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 52, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Terrebonne Parish. First elected in 2015, Jerome Zeringue serves as vice chair of the Appropriations Committee and chairs the House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jerome Zeringue's occupation as principal of Progressive Coastal Consultants, with a B.S. in zoology and an M.S. in fisheries science from Louisiana State University and postgraduate studies at Tulane University.

The House page lists Jerome Zeringue's committee assignments as Appropriations (vice chair), Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery (chair), Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee, and Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
